components.title: Hero
components.desc: Shared page hero. One CSS file, one BEM block (.rbccm-hero), five variants, each with its own TeamSite skin. All five skins share one Properties file.

components.title: Intro Statement
components.desc: Big centred serif statement, up to 3 paragraphs and a ghost pill button. Extracted from the MAAS+MATA "A new standard for multi-asset electronic trading." section (.rbccm-maas-mata__new-standard), with the values the live page...

components.title: Video Poster
components.desc: Rounded poster image with a centred play button that opens a Brightcove video in a modal. Extracted from the MAAS+MATA page (the "Execution Console" image under the hero).

components.title: Accordions
components.desc: Shared disclosure/accordion component. One CSS partial, one BEM block (.rbccm-accordions), per-page variant modifiers (.rbccm-accordions--strategy-and-economics-notes, etc.).

components.title: Awards
components.desc: A row of award cards on a dark navy background, with an optional caption line above the cards. Each card shows a year, an award title and the issuer.

components.title: Capability Cards
components.desc: A section header (eyebrow, heading, description) followed by a set of capability cards. Each card has an icon, a title, an optional italic subtitle and body copy.

components.title: Expertise
components.desc: Shared pillar/column-list component. Section header + N pillars, each with an icon, title, and short body.

components.title: Numbered Features
components.desc: Heading + intro line, then exactly 3 numbered features (/01 /02 /03) separated by thin grey rules.

components.title: Platforms
components.desc: Section header + 2x2 grid of feature-tile cards. Each card is a navy tile with a right-aligned bg photo that fades under a left-to-right navy gradient; title + body + gold "Explore" CTA sit over the dark left half.

components.title: Two-Up Cards
components.desc: A section header (eyebrow, heading, description) with one or two cards beside each other. Three TeamSite skins share one Properties file: one for feature lists and two for video. The skin decides what a card shows.

components.title: Filtered Content
components.desc: One component, four presets: a filter bar (dropdowns, optional search, Clear filters, active-filter chips) over a paginated list of cards.

components.title: Featured Insights
components.desc: A hand-picked "Featured insights" section: a section title and optional subhead, four insight tiles (one large featured tile and three regular tiles) and a "View all" link at the bottom left.

components.title: In the Media
components.desc: Section title + featured video card + list of media appearances + "See all" link. Whole thing lives in a shared component so the same layout can be dropped onto Strategy & Economics (and any future landing page).

components.title: Insight Cards
components.desc: A section of story cards: an eyebrow, heading and intro, then up to five stories. Each story shows an image with an optional pill and type icon, a category label, the title, a summary, a meta line, an action link and a share...

components.title: Insight List
components.desc: A section heading and intro, then a list of up to four stories. Each story shows an image, a category label, the title, a summary, a meta line and a button to the story. Built for the ETF Innovators "More on ETFs" section.

components.title: Strategic Themes
components.desc: An eyebrow and heading, then up to five themes. Each theme shows its number, a title, a description, a button and an animated graphic. Built for the "Strategic themes" section of the 2027 Outlook page.

components.title: Host Profile
components.desc: One person presented as a host: section heading, photo, name, role, up to three bio paragraphs, a LinkedIn link and up to six media appearances. Built for the ETF Innovators "Meet the host" section.

components.title: Leadership
components.desc: A leadership team section: a heading, an optional subheading and a row of people cards (photo, name, role). Each card can carry a LinkedIn link, a Biography button that opens a pop-up, or both.

components.title: Leading Experts
components.desc: Three-card grid of expert profiles. Each card = eyebrow pill + duotone-blue headshot + name/role/CTA on a navy tile. Mounts under the "Areas of expertise" section on the Strategy & Economics page.

components.title: Button
components.desc: Shared stylesheet for the pill-shaped buttons used on RBCCM pages. It has no TeamSite skin and no fields of its own: it only styles buttons that other components print with the rbccm-button classes.

components.title: CTA Band
components.desc: Shared component. Four TeamSite skins, one per variant, sharing one Properties file. All three render a centered stack (optional eyebrow → heading → body → button row) on a dark navy surface; the skin picks the typography ramp,...

components.title: Marketo Footer
components.desc: "Stay informed" sign-up band: a heading, a subheading and an embedded Marketo form. The form's fields, consent checkbox and button are built by Marketo; this component places the form on the page and adds the heading above it.

components.title: Marketo Modal
components.desc: "Talk with an expert." pop-up with an embedded Marketo form. It stays hidden until a visitor clicks any link on the page whose URL is # plus the Modal ID (default #request-demo), for example the hero and CTA band "Request a demo"...

components.title: Animate
components.desc: A small script that fades page content in: hero content as the page loads, and sections as they scroll into view. It is shared by the pages built from rbccm-* components, so they all move with the same pacing.

components.title: Brightcove Background Layer
components.desc: A stylesheet that turns a Brightcove video player into a silent, decorative background video: no controls, no play button, no title or captions, nothing clickable.

components.title: rbccm-disclaimer
components.desc: One paragraph of small grey disclaimer copy at the foot of a page.

components.title: JSON Schema
components.desc: Standalone TeamSite component for injecting Google-readable JSON-LD structured data into any page.

components.title: Section Group
components.desc: Wraps a run of separately placed sections in one div, so a shared background (the MAAS+MATA dark-strip gradient) runs continuously behind them.

components.title: MAAS+MATA Page
components.desc: The original whole-page template for the MAAS+MATA page (Multi-Asset Agency Solutions). One TeamSite skin and one set of fields output the full page body, from the hero down to the demo call to action.
